start.speaker: Ivo Kell
start.text: Keep your voice down, the aisle carries. I am the clerk of this vault. I have a page that ought to be read by somebody who is not me. Are you going up? I can walk. I have been telling myself that for a while now.

choices.text: I am going down, not up.

taken.speaker: Ivo Kell
taken.text: Then the page comes with us. If the vault takes me, make sure somebody else reads it.

left.speaker: Ivo Kell
left.text: Then I will keep the page dry and wait. Come back by this aisle when your road turns upward.

committed.speaker: Ivo Kell
committed.text: The page stays with me until the ascent. Keep the path open.

already.speaker: An empty landing
already.text: Somebody sat here long enough to wear the stone smooth. Whoever it was is not sitting here now.
